svg.aria-label: Sequence diagram of the candidate application path: rate limiting and validation, resume text extraction, an in-request Gemini screening call, persistence and an event log entry before the 201 response, with the recruiter email deferred to the after hook. Three measured weaknesses are annotated at the points where they occur.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The public, unauthenticated entry point. Unlike publishing, the AI call runs inside the request — the candidate waits for it. Red callouts mark weaknesses measured in the evaluation.

svg.text: Publishing defers its AI work to after(); this path does not. Extraction and the Gemini call sit between the candidate and their

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: confirmation, so the applicant waits on a third-party model — measured p50 1335 ms, p95 1995 ms.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The score is needed before the row is written, so the ordering is deliberate; deferring it would return 201 faster but leave the application briefly unscored.
